title: Claude in Google Docs Is NOT Free for Everyone! #shorts
description:
The official Claude for Google Workspace add-on puts Claude into Google Docs, Sheets and Slides. It's a beta for Pro, Max, Team and Enterprise plans, and Google Workspace admins may restrict Marketplace installs. Under Ask before edits, it seeks permission for changes. It does NOT automatically read your entire Drive. This is an original illustrated explainer, not an actual captured product demo.

Would you choose ASK FIRST or ACCEPT ALL? Reply below.

Anthropic instructions and limitations: https://support.claude.com/en/articles/16951679-use-claude-in-google-docs-sheets-and-slides
Marketplace app: https://workspace.google.com/marketplace/app/claude/12459801340
